spoken_first_2s: फेस्टिवल्स आ रहे हैं इसलिए मैंने कुछ बैक

notes.hook: 'Festivals aa rahe hain isliye maine kuch backdrop mangaye hain'
notes.what_goes_wrong: A seasonal hook, but 51 seconds of 'affordable' and 'bahut accha lagta hai' with no single price and a comment-for-link ask: a catalogue, not a story.
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: 'affordable' with no price; show one room before and after and say what the backdrop cost.
